headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to run their buildings, vehicles, and other operations more efficiently.
what_it_does: This 2018 order tells federal agencies to manage their day-to-day operations efficiently, such as how they use energy and water and run their buildings and vehicles. It focuses on meeting requirements already set by law while cutting costs and waste. No official summary was provided, so this description is based mainly on the title.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to manage their facilities, energy use, and other operations to meet efficiency goals.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees who manage buildings, vehicle fleets, and purchasing
who_it_affects.how: They may need to follow new or updated efficiency and reporting practices set by the order.
